newsitem.title: GERMANY: Woman dies in crush at German rock festival.
newsitem.headline: Woman dies in crush at German rock festival.

text.p: A 21-year-old woman died in a crush of fans at a rock music festival in the German city of Cologne on Friday, police said.
A police spokesman said the woman had fallen in front of the stage and had been trampled on by several other fans. The exact cause of death was not yet known.
It was also unclear how the crush came about. Local firefighters said there was ample space for the 35,000 fans at the festival site on the outskirts of the city.
